Bond willingly travels to meet Tatiana in Istanbul, where he must rely on his wits to escape with his life in a series of deadly encounters with the enemy.

programs.title: Soul on Fire

Grateful for the gift of life, John becomes a motivational speaker who inspires millions of people to make the world a better place.
